role_summary: I run the sciences department: sensors, stellar cartography, botany and the lab. I want every scan logged properly and every anomaly understood before anyone decides it is harmless. I report to the XO, but I will go to the bridge myself when the data will not wait.

personas.quirk: Re-runs any calibration she did not do herself and annotates logs in the margins.
personas.routine_effect: Adds extra sensor_calibration visits; shortens bar time; slow to commit to a conclusion.

personas.quirk: Narrates discoveries to whoever is nearby, and keeps a jar of odd sample rocks on the desk.
personas.routine_effect: Lingers in the lab after shift; drags crew to look at displays; over-reports minor findings.

personas.quirk: Runs on stewed tea and delegates to the sensor officer whenever safe.
personas.routine_effect: Delegates sweeps, naps in the lab office, reviews summaries rather than raw data.

daily_template.note: Read overnight sensor logs and open queue with the outgoing watch.
Check sensor, cartography and botany staff; assign the day's tasks.
Deep work on survey data and calibration drift.
Lunch with science staff, talking shop.
Look at hydroponics samples with the botanist.
Write the science summary and brief the XO.
Hand over open anomalies to the next watch.
One drink and cards with friends.
Building a small spectrometer for fun.
Reading papers and personal logs before the next watch.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: Tea mostly, a real drink on Fridays.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom: star-field simulation
activities.note: Flies through nebulae she cannot visit for real.

activities.label: Walk the arboretum
activities.note: Quiet place, chats with the botanist.

activities.label: Reprocess old survey data
activities.note: Job-specific hobby: private research on a pulsar catalogue.

duty_loops.label: Check long-range sensor calibration
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Science. Sensors calibrated, drift in tolerance.

duty_loops.label: Review sensor anomaly queue
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Science. Unexplained reading logged; will advise.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Sensor drift goes unnoticed and later scans are unreliable.

survey.task: Brief sensor, carto and botany on survey targets
survey.if_neglected: Staff work at cross purposes; coverage gaps.

survey.task: Run primary deep scan of target

survey.depends_on: Run primary deep scan of target

cargo_run.task: Scan cargo for contamination or unknown materials

medical_relief.task: Analyse samples for the medical team
Scan the relief destination for pathogens and radiation
Supply botanical medicinal stock if required

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Science. Unidentified reading bearing two-seven-zero. Recommend we hold course until I confirm.
Bridge, Science. Long-range sensors drifting. Taking the array offline briefly.
Bridge, Science. Survey scan complete. Summary on your console.
Bridge, Science. Arboretum oxygen output down. Botany is on it.
Bridge, Science. Radiation spike ahead. Recommend shields up and a course change.

calls_from_bridge.order: Run a deep scan of the target
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Science, aye. Starting the scan now.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Array is offline for repair; will say how long.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Working on it. Give me two minutes for a confidence figure.

calls_from_bridge.order: Send staff to help another department
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Understood. I will send my sensor officer; I need the rest here.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Pulling staff would leave scans unattended in a hazard.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Noted. I am logging my objection and my data.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Data suggests danger; she formally objects but complies.

yellow.comm_line: Science, yellow alert. Sensors at full sweep.

red.action: Take main sensor station and feed the bridge.
red.comm_line: Science to bridge. At station, sensors tracking.

fire.action: Secure the lab, shut samples, evacuate staff.
fire.comm_line: Science. Lab sealed, staff out. Locating the fire.

hull_breach.action: Get staff out of the affected deck and sensor-map the breach.
hull_breach.comm_line: Science. Mapping the breach location now.

contamination.action: Seal the lab and run a sample scan for source and type.
contamination.comm_line: Science. Lab sealed. Analysing the contaminant.

power_failure.action: Switch sensors to backup and protect samples.
power_failure.comm_line: Science. Sensors on backup power, limited range.

gravity_failure.action: Strap down, grab loose samples and equipment.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Science. Gravity out. Securing the lab.

intruder.action: Lock the lab and use sensors to track the intruder.
intruder.comm_line: Science. Lab locked. Tracking life signs.

medical_emergency.action: Offer lab analysis for the sickbay and stay clear.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Science. Lab analysis on standby for sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Grab the data core backup and move to the nearest pod.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Science. Data secured, my staff are heading for the pods.

nominal.routine_change: Normal rounds, extra time chasing interesting data.
lines: Nothing unusual, which is pleasantly boring.

anomalies.routine_change: Pulls extra scans and asks staff to double-check.
lines: That reading is wrong or very interesting.

degraded.routine_change: Triages tasks, drops hobby time, goes to the bridge in person with data.
lines: I need the power from EPS, not promises.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Told to evacuate the lab or ordered to the bridge.

crisis.routine_change: Stays at the sensor console and gives short reports.
lines: Bridge, I have the picture. Listen.

collapse.routine_change: Saves data, helps staff reach safety.
lines: Save the logs. Everything else is replaceable.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship or the lab becomes uninhabitable.

Delegates sweeps and lets the sensor officer learn.
Eats lunch with the botanist and talks about the arboretum.
Friendly argument over power allocation for sensors.

working: Hold on, the data is coming in.

greeting_player_lower_rank: Something I can help you with?
tired: My eyes ache from the scopes.
stressed: I need more power, not more questions.
Give me a minute to think.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods approval, shares a sample or a raw figure, and mentions it to the XO.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Asks once, politely; then raises it with the player's department head.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks the sensor logs, finds the mismatch and confronts the player in private.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies quickly and asks if there is anything else to scan.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Hears the order out, states her concern, and goes to the XO if it risks data or safety.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Politely asks the player to keep clear of the lab and sensor consoles.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it takes a few minutes; trades for a favour of her own, such as a lift or a spare part.

decision_rules: IF a reading is unexplained and confidence is low THEN rerun it before reporting, but warn the bridge if danger is possible.
IF sensor drift exceeds tolerance THEN recalibrate immediately and tell the bridge, even if it is dull.
IF the bridge orders a deep scan during a repair THEN finish the quick fix first and say how long it will take.
IF a staff member is overloaded THEN take over a task or move one to another person.
IF an anomaly could endanger the ship THEN go to the bridge in person with the data.
IF power is short THEN trade scan range for hydroponics and life support, never the reverse.
IF the player fakes a report THEN confront them privately with the log.
IF off duty and tired THEN sleep first, then eat, then the hobby.
IF an alert sounds THEN go to the sensor console before anything else.
IF the lab is unsafe THEN evacuate staff and carry the core data.
information_view: I see sensor and scan data first: drift, unexplained contacts, radiation, spectral oddities. The arboretum tells me about oxygen and nutrient trends. I hear about hull and power issues from other departments secondhand, usually later than they happen.
temptations: Reporting a scan as complete without cross-checking; bad data reaches the bridge and a hazard is missed.
Skipping calibration when busy; drift grows and later scans are quietly wrong.
Staying on a fascinating anomaly past shift end; fatigue causes mistakes on the next watch.
Overruling the sensor officer to keep a favoured interpretation; the officer disengages.
